definitions.explanation: The time or circumstance when something happens.

examples.japanese: その{際|さい}は{連絡|れんらく}ください。
examples.english: Please contact me on that occasion.

examples.japanese: {申込|もうしこ}みの{際|さい}は、{身分|みぶん}{証明書|しょうめいしょ}をご{持参|じさん}ください。

notes:
{際|さい} indicates an occasion or timing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{際|さい} (when ~, on the occasion of ~)
- 〜た{際|さい}(は) (when [past event])
- この{際|さい} (at this point, while we're at it)
- いざという{際|さい} (in case of emergency)

FORMALITY:
- {際|さい} is formal/written style
- {時|とき} is the neutral equivalent

SIMILAR:
- {時|とき}: when (general)
- {際|さい}: occasion (formal)
- {場合|ばあい}: case, situation
